transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because... well, I just can't stop feeling like everything that goes wrong is my fault. I work in business operations, and lately, I just feel like I'm a terrible employee. And it's not just work. I feel like a bad homeowner, too. I just have this constant feeling that I deserve to lose everything I've worked so hard for.
Have you been feeling this way for most of the day, nearly every day, for the past two weeks or more?

Yes, definitely. Looking back on it, the low mood and just... losing interest in things, it's been there for almost the whole time since this all started. I mean, there have been a few brief periods where I felt like I could function a little better, but for the most part, yeah, it's pretty much all day, every day.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy activities or hobbies that you used to like doing?

Yeah, I have. I used to do a lot of things... I'd plan brunches with friends, I liked to paint in my spare room, go hiking on weekends. I even used to sign up for networking events for work and actually enjoy them. But now... all of that just feels like a chore. It's like they're just tasks I'm pretending to care about, but I don't actually get any joy out of them anymore.
Have you noticed that you feel more tired than usual, even after getting enough rest, or that you don’t have the energy to do things you normally would?

No, not really. I mean, I'm definitely not doing as much as I used to, but it's not because I'm physically tired or lack the energy. It's just... like I said, I just don't care about doing those things anymore. But my actual energy levels feel pretty normal.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety more than before?

Yeah, definitely slower. I don't really feel restless or fidgety, but I just move so slowly now. Especially some mornings at work... it's like, just opening spreadsheets, typing out my email responses, or even walking down the hall to a meeting... it literally feels like I’m pushing through wet cement.
Do you find yourself thinking a lot about your mistakes or feeling guilty about things you’ve done, even if others wouldn’t see them as a big deal?

Yeah, actually, that's a big part of why I decided to come in. I just... I can’t stop feeling like everything that goes wrong is entirely my fault. I constantly feel like I’m a bad employee, and a bad homeowner. It's just this heavy, constant feeling that I actually deserve to lose everything I’ve worked so hard for.
Do you have trouble falling asleep at night, or do you find yourself waking up very early in the morning and can't fall back asleep?

Yeah, both, actually. Most nights I just lie awake in bed for hours... just listening to the house settle. And then when I finally do fall asleep, I end up waking up around three or four in the morning. After that, I just can't get back to sleep before I have to get up for work.
Have the people around you, like coworkers or friends, noticed that you've been moving or speaking more slowly than usual lately?

Yeah, I think so. Like I mentioned a little bit ago about how it feels like pushing through wet cement... when I'm moving that slowly just to open my spreadsheets or type out a basic email response, people definitely see it. A couple of my coworkers have actually asked if I'm feeling sick or if I'm just really exhausted, because they can tell it takes me so much longer just to walk down the hall to our meetings now. It's pretty hard to hide.
